summary: On May 21, 2026 a Fox Rothschild LLP employee was targeted in a voice phishing (vishing) attack, and the attacker copied and took files from a single device tied to that employee's account. The law firm found the unusual activity the same day, completed its review of affected files containing client and other personal information on June 18, and notified affected individuals in July 2026 with credit monitoring. The firm said the incident did not reach its broader network.
